en_title: Elden Ring Movie's Budget Reportedly $200 Million, Almost 3x More Expensive Than A24's Marty Supreme
cn_title: 《艾尔登法环》电影据报耗资2亿美元(约合人民币13亿元)
subtitle: 看点来了
opus_summary: 据《华尔街日报》援引消息人士报道，Alex Garland执导的《艾尔登法环》真人电影预算接近A24此前最贵影片的三倍，若属实，将成为该公司预算最高的电影。影片已于今年7月杀青，预计于2028年3月3日上映。

paragraphs.en: Alex Garland's Elden Ring movie reportedly carries a hefty budget of almost $200 million, making it A24's most expensive movie ever – and it's not close.
paragraphs.cn: 据报道，Alex Garland执导的《艾尔登法环》电影预算接近2亿美元(约合人民币13亿元)，不仅是A24有史以来最昂贵的电影，而且远远超过该公司的其他作品。

paragraphs.en: Background information on the live-action adaptation of FromSoftware and George R.R. Martin's 2022 RPG was shared in a Wall Street Journal report. The site stated that, according to its sources, Elden Ring's budget is "nearly $200 million."
paragraphs.cn: 《华尔街日报》分享了From Software与George R.R. Martin于2022年推出的RPG真人改编电影的相关背景信息。据该媒体报道，消息人士透露，《艾尔登法环》的预算「接近2亿美元(约合人民币13亿元)」。

paragraphs.en: That makes it far and away the most expensive movie for the arthouse film-focused company, which has built a reputation for delivering memorable projects on more modest budgets for the last 14 years. Should Elden Ring's reported budget prove accurate, it would mean Garland's film falls in line with Marvel movies like Spider-Man: No Way Home ($200 million via Variety ) and Jurassic World Rebirth ($180 million via The Hollywood Reporter ).
paragraphs.cn: 这使它成为这家专注于艺术电影的公司迄今为止预算最高的电影，且领先幅度十分明显。过去14年来，A24一直凭借相对有限的预算打造出许多令人难忘的作品。如果《艾尔登法环》的报道预算属实，那么它的成本将与《蜘蛛侠：英雄无归》这类漫威电影相当，后者预算为2亿美元(约合人民币13亿元)（据《综艺》报道），而《侏罗纪世界：重生》的预算则为1.8亿美元(约合人民币12亿元)（据《好莱坞报道者》报道）。

paragraphs.en: As seen in 2025's Marty Supreme , that's a far cry from A24's usual strategy. The Timothée Chalamet-led, Josh Safdie-directed drama made headlines ahead of its release for being the most expensive film the company had produced at $70 million (via Deadline ).
paragraphs.cn: 正如2025年的《Marty Supreme》所展示的那样，这与A24一贯的策略相去甚远。这部由Timothée Chalamet主演、Josh Safdie执导的剧情片上映前曾因成为该公司制作成本最高的电影而登上新闻，预算为7000万美元(约合人民币5亿元)（据Deadline报道）。

paragraphs.en: That puts Elden Ring at nearly three times the cost of A24's next-most-expensive picture. Garland's Civil War supposedly cost $50 million before that, according to Variety . Dwayne 'The Rock' Johnson's The Smashing Machine reportedly carried a similar budget. In other words, nothing really comes close to A24's first major swing into the world of video game movie adaptations.
paragraphs.cn: 这意味着《艾尔登法环》的成本接近A24下一部预算最高电影的三倍。在此之前，Garland执导的《内战》据称耗资5000万美元(约合人民币3亿元)，这一数字来自《综艺》的报道。Dwayne「The Rock」Johnson主演的《The Smashing Machine》据报道也采用了相近的预算。换句话说，A24首次大举进军电子游戏电影改编领域，确实没有哪部作品能与之相提并论。

paragraphs.en: For now, we know little about Elden Ring ahead of its 2028 premiere, so it's hard to say exactly why it costs so much. Earlier this year, the movie studio announced the film had a pretty stacked cast, which includes familiar faces like Kit Connor (X-Men, Warfare), Cailee Spaeny (Alien: Romulus, Civil War), Nick Offerman (The Last of Us, Parks and Recreation), Havana Rose Liu (Tuner, Bottoms), and more. Early production photos then teased faithful recreations of some iconic sets, with more making their way to the internet not long after .
paragraphs.cn: 目前，关于《艾尔登法环》的信息仍然很少，而影片要到2028年才上映，因此我们很难确切判断它为何需要如此高昂的成本。今年早些时候，制片方宣布影片拥有一套相当亮眼的演员阵容，其中包括Kit Connor（《X战警》系列、《Warfare》）、Cailee Spaeny（《异形：罗穆卢斯》《内战》）、Nick Offerman（《最后生还者》《公园与游憩》）、Havana Rose Liu（《Tuner》《Bottoms》）等。随后公开的早期制作照片还展示了部分标志性场景的高度还原版本，没过多久，更多照片也陆续出现在网上。

paragraphs.en: The Elden Ring movie's big budget may not have always been the plan for what's shaping up to, one way or another, be a massive release for A24. Previous reports had the live-action fantasy flick pinned at just more than $100 million , suggesting either that initial rumors were inaccurate or Garland's budget somehow ballooned over the course of production. Filming finally wrapped in July of this year.
paragraphs.cn: 无论如何，《艾尔登法环》电影看来都将成为A24的一部重磅作品，但如此高昂的预算或许并非最初的计划。此前有报道称，这部真人奇幻电影的预算仅略高于1亿美元(约合人民币7亿元)（人民币换算待核实）。这表明，要么最初的传闻不准确，要么Garland执导的这部电影在制作过程中因某种原因预算大幅膨胀。影片终于在今年7月杀青。

paragraphs.en: The Elden Ring movie was announced in May 2025 and is expected to premiere March 3, 2028. It will probably be a little while longer before we see any official images or a trailer, so in the meantime, you can read about how actor and Dark Souls superfan Peter Serafinowicz landed a role in the film .
paragraphs.cn: 《艾尔登法环》电影于2025年5月公布，预计将于2028年3月3日首映。我们可能还要再等一段时间，才能看到官方剧照或预告片。在此期间，你可以先了解演员、《黑暗之魂》忠实粉丝Peter Serafinowicz是如何获得片中角色的。
